title: We just raised $400M in Series C funding to help people run their businesses | Lovable
excerpt: Lovable has raised $400 million in Series C funding at a $13.3 billion valuation, led by Menlo Ventures and the Scaleup Europe Fund, managed by EQT.
content_html:
Today, we’re announcing that Lovable has raised $400 million in Series C funding at a $13.3 billion valuation, led by Menlo Ventures and co-led by the Scaleup Europe Fund, managed by EQT. The round also welcomes Balderton Capital and Carmignac from Europe, Kaszek Ventures and LTS Growth from Latin America, Tencent and World Innovation Lab from Asia, and Regent from the United States, broadening the group of investors backing Lovable’s global ambition. Returning investors include Accel, Antler, CapitalG, DST Global, Evantic Capital, HubSpot Ventures, and Salesforce Ventures.

Lovable is building the software creation platform that gives those closest to a problem the power to solve it, a generational opportunity that spans billions of people all over the world. This investment moves Lovable closer to becoming the one place where people create new businesses and transform existing ones.

What we’ve been working on

For most people, turning an idea into software once required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable’s first chapter was about changing that. Since Lovable’s launch in November 2024, people have created more than 60 million projects, and Lovable-built apps see over 900 million visits every month. Within its first year, Lovable reached employees at half of the Fortune 500; now, less than a year later, that figure has grown to nearly two-thirds.

Since our Series B in December 2025, we’ve been building features people need to reach customers, manage day-to-day operations, and run software securely. A few highlights include:

  • Payment functionality that helps people monetize
  • SEO and AI-search tools that improve discoverability
  • Deeper integrations with Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, Salesforce, Stripe, and ElevenLabs
  • Automatic and scheduled security scanning
  • Earning AIUC-1 certification, the first security standard for AI agents
  • Governance and visibility features including publishing controls, abandoned app clean-up, and workspace insights
  • A dedicated security page for businesses built on Lovable: publicly published Lovable apps can now come with their own trust center

For many builders, the product they create with Lovable is becoming the business itself. User survey data shows us that nearly 8 in 10 are building a business or side project they hope to monetize, and more than one-third of those are already earning revenue.

Inside established companies like Adidas, NVIDIA, and Deutsche Telekom, teams are using Lovable to create software around critical workflows, replace tools that no longer serve them, and turn promising internal projects into new products and revenue streams.

A few of our favorite stories:

  1. WNTD [United Kingdom]: Lex Deak, a serial founder with 25+ years experience, built fashion discovery app WNTD using Lovable — saving £25-30K every month, onboarding hundreds of thousands of customers, and closing a £3M funding round.
  2. Viver de IA [Brazil]: Rafael Milagre built the systems behind his AI education company with Lovable, including its CRM, finance tools, website, and AI SDR workflows. The 54-person company serves more than 1,200 clients and is on track for R$100 million in revenue this year.
  3. Nursa [United States]: Nursa’s VP of Product, Nenad Ivanovic, built Nursa Study, a new enterprise product for nursing schools, in a single weekend with Lovable. The company has since rolled Lovable out across its 200+ employees, rebuilt its core platform 12x faster, and is in the process of retiring 10 SaaS systems as teams build their own tools.

In our customers’ own words:

Jorge Luthe, Senior Director of Product, Zendesk:

What started as a faster way to prototype has become an important tool for building internal products that support how our teams work. With Lovable, we’ve been able to build solutions tailored to our business needs, from internal training tools to a roadmap application that better fits our workflow and reduces reliance on expensive off-the-shelf software.

Veronika Zatulovskaya, VP of Marketing, Handshake:

Lovable has changed how we think about building internal software. Instead of adding another tool to our marketing stack, our teams can quickly create whatever they need to solve problems — a campaign planning tool, an onboarding experience, or an internal AI resource hub. This gives us more control over how we work and allows us to move faster.

Luca Bonmassar, CTO, Checkr:

With Lovable, our teams are quickly able to build solutions themselves. Our operations team fixed an issue in their QA workflow and can now process 10x more reports. We also built an internal operating system that brings business reviews, roadmaps, OKRs, and project tracking into one place, so our largest org stays aligned and can move faster. Throughout our business, domain experts are building what they need, bespoke to their needs.

Nico Wittenberg, Founder, AVARA:

I first had the idea for AVARA 14 years ago, but building it seemed impossible without millions in funding and a large engineering team. With Lovable, I was able to turn that idea into a real product all by myself. AVARA is now being used in more than 100 countries, and we’re building the travel experience I always believed should exist.

What’s next

Lovable will move faster on the product, infrastructure, and team needed to deliver on our mission: to create a world where the people closest to a problem have the power to solve it.

We have three priorities that will shape what you see from Lovable next:

1. Make Lovable the best platform to build and run your business

Our product will become more proactive: understanding what people are trying to achieve, identifying what needs attention, and increasingly helping carry out the work without waiting to be prompted. Deeper integrations will connect Lovable more closely to an organization’s existing technology stack, allowing teams to build richer, more personalized dashboards and workflows across sales, operations, marketing, and beyond. We will also keep strengthening security, reliability, permissions, and governance so people can continue to trust the software that increasingly helps them operate their businesses.

2. Train the system on what success looks like

As millions of people build with Lovable, the system gets better at understanding which choices lead to stronger outcomes. Our goal is to understand not only whether products are built correctly, but whether they go on to create meaningful outcomes, such as generating revenue, improving a workflow, or helping a business grow. This compounding loop surfaces aggregate patterns, which helps us improve the experience for every builder. Each successful product makes the system smarter, and a smarter system helps more people succeed.

Lovable will continue to draw on the strengths of multiple models, matching each part of the work to the model best suited to handle it and bringing the results together into one seamless experience. We will also continue post-training promising open-source models, with the goal of making the Lovable experience increasingly personal to each person’s goals, context, and way of working. As the AI ecosystem advances, Lovable will turn breakthroughs into better outcomes for the people and businesses building with us.

3. Assemble generational talent to build what is next

Exceptional products are downstream of exceptional people. We plan to grow to roughly 450 team members this year, hiring most heavily in machine learning, product, infrastructure, and security roles. We will keep our center of gravity in Stockholm while expanding in London, Boston, San Francisco, and New York. We are relentless in recruiting the world’s best talent to make Lovable a beloved, enduring product for our customers and build a generational company with deep European roots and extensive global reach.

The lead investors backing Lovable’s next chapter

Menlo Ventures has backed some of the most consequential companies of the AI era, and their decision to deepen their commitment reflects a conviction that Lovable will be an enduring force in what comes next. EQT has chosen Lovable among its first investments of the Scaleup Europe Fund, placing us at the heart of a new effort to help Europe’s most ambitious companies become global leaders. Together, their support in leading this round speaks to what this team has delivered, the scale of the opportunity ahead, and our ambition to build a generational technology company from Europe.

In their own words:

Matt Murphy, Partner, Menlo Ventures:

From the very start, Lovable was built for the billions of people with the creativity and knowledge to make something, but who had always been blocked by technical ability. That focus has created extraordinary growth, a product people love, and a market that expands every time someone becomes a founder or a company rethinks how software gets made. We believe Lovable is, and will continue to be, one of the most generational companies of the AI era.

Victor Englesson, Partner at EQT and Co-Head of the Scaleup Europe Fund:

Anton, Fabian, and the Lovable team have built one of the most ambitious and fastest-growing AI companies we’ve seen. They prove that Europe has no shortage of exceptional founders. We’re excited to co-lead this investment in Lovable through the Scaleup Europe Fund, which reflects exactly why the Fund was established: to help Europe’s most ambitious technology companies become global leaders.

The next generation of software will come from more founders, more places, and more teams inside companies who understand the problem firsthand. Lovable is creating a new category of possibilities for billions of people with ideas worth pursuing and problems worth solving.

If you want to help shape how software gets built, join us. And if there’s a product, internal tool, or business you believe should exist, start building it with Lovable.

blocks.html_en: What’s next

sentences.en: What’s next
sentences.zh: 接下来是什么

blocks.html_en: Lovable will move faster on the product, infrastructure, and team needed to deliver on our mission: to create a world where the people closest to a problem have the power to solve it.

sentences.en: Lovable will move faster on the product, infrastructure, and team needed to deliver on our mission: to create a world where the people closest to a problem have the power to solve it.
sentences.zh: Lovable 将在实现我们使命所需的产品、基础设施和团队方面更快地发展：创造一个最接近问题的人有能力解决问题的世界。

blocks.html_en: We have three priorities that will shape what you see from Lovable next:

sentences.en: We have three priorities that will shape what you see from Lovable next:
sentences.zh: 我们有三个优先事项将塑造您接下来对 Lovable 的看法：

blocks.html_en: 1. Make Lovable the best platform to build and run your business

sentences.en: Make Lovable the best platform to build and run your business
sentences.zh: 让 Lovable 成为建立和经营业务的最佳平台

blocks.html_en: Our product will become more proactive: understanding what people are trying to achieve, identifying what needs attention, and increasingly helping carry out the work without waiting to be prompted. Deeper integrations will connect Lovable more closely to an organization’s existing technology stack, allowing teams to build richer, more personalized dashboards and workflows across sales, operations, marketing, and beyond. We will also keep strengthening security, reliability, permissions, and governance so people can continue to trust the software that increasingly helps them operate their businesses.

sentences.en: Our product will become more proactive: understanding what people are trying to achieve, identifying what needs attention, and increasingly helping carry out the work without waiting to be prompted.
sentences.zh: 我们的产品将变得更加主动：了解人们想要实现的目标，确定需要关注的内容，并越来越多地帮助开展工作，而无需等待提示。

sentences.en: Deeper integrations will connect Lovable more closely to an organization’s existing technology stack, allowing teams to build richer, more personalized dashboards and workflows across sales, operations, marketing, and beyond.
sentences.zh: 更深入的集成将使 Lovable 与组织现有的技术堆栈更紧密地连接，从而使团队能够在销售、运营、营销等领域构建更丰富、更个性化的仪表板和工作流程。

sentences.en: We will also keep strengthening security, reliability, permissions, and governance so people can continue to trust the software that increasingly helps them operate their businesses.
sentences.zh: 我们还将不断加强安全性、可靠性、权限和治理，以便人们能够继续信任日益帮助他们运营业务的软件。

blocks.html_en: 2. Train the system on what success looks like

sentences.en: Train the system on what success looks like
sentences.zh: 训练系统了解成功是什么样子

blocks.html_en: As millions of people build with Lovable, the system gets better at understanding which choices lead to stronger outcomes. Our goal is to understand not only whether products are built correctly, but whether they go on to create meaningful outcomes, such as generating revenue, improving a workflow, or helping a business grow. This compounding loop surfaces aggregate patterns, which helps us improve the experience for every builder. Each successful product makes the system smarter, and a smarter system helps more people succeed.

sentences.en: As millions of people build with Lovable, the system gets better at understanding which choices lead to stronger outcomes.
sentences.zh: 随着数百万人使用 Lovable 进行构建，系统会更好地理解哪些选择会带来更好的结果。

sentences.en: Our goal is to understand not only whether products are built correctly, but whether they go on to create meaningful outcomes, such as generating revenue, improving a workflow, or helping a business grow.
sentences.zh: 我们的目标不仅是了解产品是否正确构建，还要了解它们是否继续创造有意义的成果，例如创收、改进工作流程或帮助业务增长。

sentences.en: This compounding loop surfaces aggregate patterns, which helps us improve the experience for every builder.
sentences.zh: 这种复合循环呈现聚合模式，这有助于我们改善每个构建者的体验。

sentences.en: Each successful product makes the system smarter, and a smarter system helps more people succeed.
sentences.zh: 每一个成功的产品都让系统变得更加智能，而更智能的系统帮助更多的人成功。

blocks.html_en: Lovable will continue to draw on the strengths of multiple models, matching each part of the work to the model best suited to handle it and bringing the results together into one seamless experience. We will also continue post-training promising open-source models, with the goal of making the Lovable experience increasingly personal to each person’s goals, context, and way of working. As the AI ecosystem advances, Lovable will turn breakthroughs into better outcomes for the people and businesses building with us.

sentences.en: Lovable will continue to draw on the strengths of multiple models, matching each part of the work to the model best suited to handle it and bringing the results together into one seamless experience.
sentences.zh: Lovable 将继续利用多个模型的优势，将工作的每个部分与最适合处理它的模型相匹配，并将结果整合为一种无缝体验。

sentences.en: We will also continue post-training promising open-source models, with the goal of making the Lovable experience increasingly personal to each person’s goals, context, and way of working.
sentences.zh: 我们还将在培训后继续开发有前途的开源模型，目标是使 Lovable 体验更加个性化，适合每个人的目标、环境和工作方式。

sentences.en: As the AI ecosystem advances, Lovable will turn breakthroughs into better outcomes for the people and businesses building with us.
sentences.zh: 随着人工智能生态系统的进步，Lovable 将把突破转化为与我们一起建设的人们和企业更好的成果。

blocks.html_en: 3. Assemble generational talent to build what is next

sentences.en: Assemble generational talent to build what is next
sentences.zh: 聚集一代又一代的人才，打造下一代

blocks.html_en: Exceptional products are downstream of exceptional people. We plan to grow to roughly 450 team members this year, hiring most heavily in machine learning, product, infrastructure, and security roles. We will keep our center of gravity in Stockholm while expanding in London, Boston, San Francisco, and New York. We are relentless in recruiting the world’s best talent to make Lovable a beloved, enduring product for our customers and build a generational company with deep European roots and extensive global reach.

sentences.en: We will keep our center of gravity in Stockholm while expanding in London, Boston, San Francisco, and New York.
sentences.zh: 我们将把重心保持在斯德哥尔摩，同时在伦敦、波士顿、旧金山和纽约扩张。

sentences.en: We are relentless in recruiting the world’s best talent to make Lovable a beloved, enduring product for our customers and build a generational company with deep European roots and extensive global reach.
sentences.zh: 我们坚持不懈地招募世界上最优秀的人才，使 Lovable 成为深受客户喜爱、经久不衰的产品，并打造一家扎根欧洲、影响全球的世代公司。

blocks.html_en: The lead investors backing Lovable’s next chapter

sentences.en: The lead investors backing Lovable’s next chapter
sentences.zh: 主要投资者支持 Lovable 的下一章

blocks.html_en: Menlo Ventures has backed some of the most consequential companies of the AI era, and their decision to deepen their commitment reflects a conviction that Lovable will be an enduring force in what comes next. EQT has chosen Lovable among its first investments of the Scaleup Europe Fund, placing us at the heart of a new effort to help Europe’s most ambitious companies become global leaders. Together, their support in leading this round speaks to what this team has delivered, the scale of the opportunity ahead, and our ambition to build a generational technology company from Europe.

blocks.html_en: From the very start, Lovable was built for the billions of people with the creativity and knowledge to make something, but who had always been blocked by technical ability. That focus has created extraordinary growth, a product people love, and a market that expands every time someone becomes a founder or a company rethinks how software gets made. We believe Lovable is, and will continue to be, one of the most generational companies of the AI era.

content_html_zh:
今天，我们宣布 Lovable 已筹集 4 亿美元的 C 轮融资，估值为 133 亿美元，由 Menlo Ventures 领投，由 EQT 管理的 Scaleup Europe Fund 联合领投。 本轮融资还迎来了来自欧洲的 Balderton Capital 和 Carmignac、来自拉丁美洲的 Kaszek Ventures 和 LTS Growth、来自亚洲的腾讯和 World Innovation Lab 以及来自美国的 Regent，从而扩大了支持 Lovable 全球雄心的投资者群体。 返回的投资者包括 Accel、Antler、CapitalG、DST Global、Evantic Capital、HubSpot Ventures 和 Salesforce Ventures。

Lovable 正在构建一个软件创建平台，为那些最接近问题的人提供解决问题的能力，这是一个覆盖全球数十亿人的世代机会。 这项投资使 Lovable 更接近成为人们创建新业务和改造现有业务的地方。

我们一直在做什么

对于大多数人来说，将一个想法变成软件曾经需要大量的资金、熟练的技术和时间，以至于许多想法从未成为现实。 《Loveable》的第一章就是要改变这一点。 自 Lovable 于 2024 年 11 月推出以来，人们已经创建了超过 6000 万个项目，Lovable 构建的应用程序每月的访问量超过 9 亿次。 在推出的第一年，Lovable 的员工就覆盖了一半的财富 500 强企业；现在，不到一年后，这个数字已增长到近三分之二。

自 2025 年 12 月推出 B 轮以来，我们一直在构建人们接触客户、管理日常运营和安全运行软件所需的功能。 一些亮点包括：

  • 帮助人们货币化的支付功能
  • 提高可发现性的 SEO 和 AI 搜索工具
  • 与 Google Workspace、Microsoft 365、Salesforce、Stripe 和 ElevenLabs 进行更深入的集成
  • 自动和预定的安全扫描
  • 获得AIUC-1认证，这是AI代理的第一个安全标准
  • 治理和可见性功能，包括发布控件、废弃应用程序清理和工作区洞察
  • 基于 Lovable 构建的企业专用安全页面：公开发布的 Lovable 应用程序现在可以拥有自己的信任中心

对于许多建筑商来说，他们与 Lovable 一起创造的产品正在成为业务本身。 用户调查数据显示，近十分之八的人正在建立他们希望货币化的业务或副项目，其中超过三分之一已经获得收入。

在阿迪达斯、NVIDIA 和德国电信等老牌公司内部，团队正在使用 Lovable 围绕关键工作流程创建软件，替换不再为他们服务的工具，并将有前景的内部项目转化为新产品和收入来源。

一些我们最喜欢的故事：

  1. WNTD [英国]：拥有 25 年以上经验的连续创始人 Lex Deak 使用 Lovable 构建了时尚发现应用程序 WNTD，每月节省 25-3 万英镑，吸引了数十万客户，并完成了 300 万英镑的融资。
  2. Viver de IA [巴西]：Rafael Milagre 与 Lovable 一起构建了他的 AI 教育公司背后的系统，包括 CRM、财务工具、网站和 AI SDR 工作流程。 这家拥有 54 名员工的公司为 1,200 多家客户提供服务，今年的收入有望达到 1 亿雷亚尔。
  3. Nursa [美国]：Nursa 的产品副总裁 Nenad Ivanovic 在一个周末与 Lovable 合作开发了 Nursa Study，这是一款针对护士学校的新企业产品。 此后，该公司在其 200 多名员工中推出了 Lovable，将其核心平台的重建速度提高了 12 倍，并且随着团队构建自己的工具，正在淘汰 10 个 SaaS 系统。

用我们客户自己的话说：

Zendesk 产品高级总监 Jorge Luthe：

最初作为一种更快的原型方法，现已成为构建支持我们团队工作方式的内部产品的重要工具。 借助 Lovable，我们能够构建适合我们业务需求的解决方案，从内部培训工具到更适合我们工作流程并减少对昂贵的现成软件的依赖的路线图应用程序。

Veronika Zatulovskaya，握手营销副总裁：

Lovable 改变了我们对构建内部软件的看法。 我们的团队无需在营销堆栈中添加其他工具，而是可以快速创建解决问题所需的任何工具——营销活动规划工具、入职体验或内部人工智能资源中心。 这使我们能够更好地控制我们的工作方式，并使我们能够更快地行动。

Luca Bonmassar，Checkr 首席技术官：

借助 Lovable，我们的团队能够快速自行构建解决方案。 我们的运营团队修复了 QA 工作流程中的问题，现在可以处理 10 倍以上的报告。 我们还构建了一个内部操作系统，将业务审查、路线图、OKR 和项目跟踪整合到一个地方，因此我们最大的组织保持一致并可以更快地行动。 在我们的整个业务中，领域专家正在根据他们的需求定制他们需要的东西。

AVARA 创始人 Nico Wittenberg：

14 年前，我第一次有了创建 AVARA 的想法，但如果没有数百万美元的资金和庞大的工程团队，构建它似乎是不可能的。 有了 Lovable，我就能够独自将这个想法变成一个真正的产品。 AVARA 目前已在 100 多个国家/地区使用，我们正在打造我一直认为应该存在的旅行体验。

接下来是什么

Lovable 将在实现我们使命所需的产品、基础设施和团队方面更快地发展：创造一个最接近问题的人有能力解决问题的世界。

我们有三个优先事项将塑造您接下来对 Lovable 的看法：

1. 让 Lovable 成为建立和经营业务的最佳平台

我们的产品将变得更加主动：了解人们想要实现的目标，确定需要关注的内容，并越来越多地帮助开展工作，而无需等待提示。 更深入的集成将使 Lovable 与组织现有的技术堆栈更紧密地连接，从而使团队能够在销售、运营、营销等领域构建更丰富、更个性化的仪表板和工作流程。 我们还将不断加强安全性、可靠性、权限和治理，以便人们能够继续信任日益帮助他们运营业务的软件。

2. 训练系统了解成功是什么样子

随着数百万人使用 Lovable 进行构建，系统会更好地理解哪些选择会带来更好的结果。 我们的目标不仅是了解产品是否正确构建，还要了解它们是否继续创造有意义的成果，例如创收、改进工作流程或帮助业务增长。 这种复合循环呈现聚合模式，这有助于我们改善每个构建者的体验。 每一个成功的产品都让系统变得更加智能，而更智能的系统帮助更多的人成功。

Lovable 将继续利用多个模型的优势，将工作的每个部分与最适合处理它的模型相匹配，并将结果整合为一种无缝体验。 我们还将在培训后继续开发有前途的开源模型，目标是使 Lovable 体验更加个性化，适合每个人的目标、环境和工作方式。 随着人工智能生态系统的进步，Lovable 将把突破转化为与我们一起建设的人们和企业更好的成果。

3. 聚集一代又一代的人才，打造下一代

卓越的产品源于卓越的人才。 我们计划今年将团队成员增加到大约 450 名，其中大部分招聘机器学习、产品、基础设施和安全职位。 我们将把重心保持在斯德哥尔摩，同时在伦敦、波士顿、旧金山和纽约扩张。 我们坚持不懈地招募世界上最优秀的人才，使 Lovable 成为深受客户喜爱、经久不衰的产品，并打造一家扎根欧洲、影响全球的世代公司。

主要投资者支持 Lovable 的下一章

Menlo Ventures 已经支持了人工智能时代一些最有影响力的公司，他们决定深化他们的承诺，反映出他们相信 Lovable 将成为未来发展的持久力量。 EQT 选择 Lovable 作为 Scaleup Europe 基金的首批投资之一，这使我们成为帮助欧洲最雄心勃勃的公司成为全球领导者的新努力的核心。 他们对领导本轮融资的支持共同体现了该团队所交付的成果、未来机遇的规模以及我们建立欧洲新一代技术公司的雄心。

用他们自己的话说：

Matt Murphy，Menlo Ventures 合伙人：

从一开始，Lovable 就是为数十亿拥有创造力和知识来创造东西但始终受到技术能力阻碍的人而建立的。 这种专注创造了非凡的增长，这是人们喜爱的产品，每当有人成为创始人或公司重新思考软件的制作方式时，市场就会扩大。 我们相信 Lovable 是、并将继续是人工智能时代最具时代意义的公司之一。

Victor Englesson，EQT 合伙人兼 Scaleup Europe 基金联席主管：

Anton、Fabian 和 Lovable 团队打造了我们所见过的最雄心勃勃、发展最快的人工智能公司之一。 他们证明欧洲并不缺乏杰出的创始人。 我们很高兴能够通过 Scaleup Europe 基金共同领导对 Lovable 的这项投资，这恰恰反映了该基金成立的原因：帮助欧洲最雄心勃勃的科技公司成为全球领导者。

下一代软件将来自更多的创始人、更多的地方以及公司内部更多的团队，他们对问题有第一手的了解。 Lovable 正在为数十亿人创造一种新的可能性，让他们拥有值得追求的想法和值得解决的问题。

如果您想帮助塑造软件的构建方式，请加入我们。 如果您认为应该存在某种产品、内部工具或业务，请开始使用 Lovable 来构建它。
